objective: Repair unreadable Genesis dark-on-dark Cluster widgets and plain/white masking on Home, Organization and Cluster dashboards. Render owner-supplied Galaxy gallery with native-bundled offline photos and focus-gated atmospheric light; retain Wall ad surfaces and current functionality.
productionBaselineEvidence: GitHub production source main 551e54602addd6f7bbe7bcdddd1589d35424c964; baseline Genesis DEV parent d301864099c0f2a2b294308f3177ca0de2430a5d. Existing installed Genesis APK user screenshots show dark-on-dark Cluster card labels and plain backgrounds. This commit does not establish signed device/OTA proof.
chosenApproach: Scoped, build-flagged React Native visual-only patch to existing screen components; import three locally optimized images from the owner's Galaxy assets library and reuse existing native-driver focus/reduced-motion guarded GenesisAtmosphere. No server writes, dependencies, backend or native SDK changes.
selectionRationale: Fix the observed typography and compositing failures at their components instead of replacing all screens or mutating reward backend; preserve current staging APK and production package until verified.
alternativeApproaches: Global theme palette replacement rejected because uncontrolled cross-screen text contrast and existing light editor controls could regress.
Network-hosted animated backgrounds rejected because poor networks, AdMob first-view and video rendering require minimal background traffic.
Native-bundled compressed galaxy photographs with existing SVG ambient motion chosen for offline, low-cost rendering.
acceptanceChecks: 11 approved photo/UI/test/doc files plus this scope manifest and one focused test; no auth, ads, finance, points or backend writes.
Readable dark Genesis cards and selected Cluster tile labels with light-on-dark contrast; light editor dialogs remain usable.
Galaxy images resolve via static Metro require, with no runtime network dependency.
Scope tabs, modal inputs, navigation and AdMob surfaces remain intact.
Moving elements respect app focus, reduced-motion setting, and device quality guard.
Focused Node tests and governance CI pass; actual Android staged visuals and navigation/ad perf require device verification before OTA.
preserveBehaviors: Production application binary, Play package, release channel, native runtime and existing prod OTA remain unchanged.
All server-authoritative rewards, Season 2 December 6 locks, privacy/RLS and member authentication remain unchanged.
AdMob first-view advertisements, offscreen video lifecycle, scroll and interactive touch targets are not obscured by image overlays.
Existing dark-mode legibility, legacy light forms and dialogs remain unchanged outside Genesis preview.
No theme selector reintroduced and one centralized Genesis design remains app-wide.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Scoped Genesis preview only controls the backdrop, typography and bundled ornamentation without changing runtime integrations.
preservedBehaviors: Production and existing native runtime remain unchanged; animations respect visibility, battery and accessibility.

preservedBehaviors: Community media hydration, reactions, interactive avatar touches and native advertisements are preserved.
